Module io.github.brantunger.unruly.core
Package io.github.brantunger.unruly.api

Class RunResult<O>

java.lang.Object
io.github.brantunger.unruly.api.RunResult<O>
Type Parameters:
O - The type of the output object
public final class RunResult<O> extends Object
What one run did: the output object, the rules that fired, what each rule's condition evaluated to, the checksum of the rules it used, and the tags and start time that chose which of them it used. Returned by RulesEngine.runWithResult(FactStore), and given to RuleListener.afterRun(RunContext, RunResult).

A run of an engine's own rules returns a result whose output() is null exactly when firedRules() is empty, which happens when the rule list is empty or no rule matched. A failed run throws instead of returning a partial result.

It's a final class rather than a record, so a later 2.x release can add accessors without breaking code compiled against this one.

  • Method Details

    • of

      public static <O> RunResult<O> of(@Nullable O output, List<Rule> firedRules, String ruleSetChecksum)
      Creates a result without evaluations. The engine creates its own; this is for a class that implements RulesEngine, such as a decorator or a test double. Its evaluations() and tags() are empty and its startedAt() is null; use of(Object, List, List, String) to report the evaluations. RunContext is sealed, its one implementation is internal to the engine, and the engine creates the contexts it passes to listeners, so an implementation carries a run's tags and start with withRun(RunContext) and a context an engine gave it, such as one its listener received.
      Type Parameters:
      O - The type of the output object
      Parameters:

    • withRun

      public RunResult<O> withRun(RunContext run)
      Returns a copy of this result that carries run's tags and start; everything else is the same. The engine calls it on the result of each of its runs before RuleListener.afterRun(RunContext, RunResult) sees it. RunContext is sealed, its one implementation is internal to the engine, and the engine creates the contexts it passes to listeners, so another implementation of RulesEngine calls it with a context an engine gave it, such as one its listener received.
      Parameters:
      run - The run whose tags and start the copy carries
      Returns:
      The copy
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if run is null

    • evaluations

      public List<RuleEvaluation> evaluations()
      Returns what each rule's condition evaluated to: one evaluation for every loaded rule, in evaluation order, the same Rule instances as RuleSetInfo.rules(). On a first-match engine, the rules after the match are RuleEvaluation.Outcome.NOT_EVALUATED; to know whether they would have matched, use an all-matches or a unique-match engine, which evaluate every condition of the rules the run uses. A rule the run skipped is RuleEvaluation.Outcome.SKIPPED on every engine. A result created with of(Object, List, String) has none.
      Returns:
      The evaluations; unmodifiable, and empty if the rule list is empty

    • ruleSetChecksum

      public String ruleSetChecksum()
      Returns the checksum of the rules this run used. During a reload it can differ from the engine's current RuleSetInfo.checksum(), because a run finishes with the rules it started with.
      Returns:
      The checksum, as RuleSetInfo.checksum() describes it

    • tags

      public Set<String> tags()
      Returns the tags the run was given, as RunContext.tags() describes them: the run used only the rules that carry at least one of them.
      Returns:
      The tags, in String order; unmodifiable, and empty if the run used every rule or the result was created with of(...) and not given a run

    • startedAt

      public @Nullable Instant startedAt()
      Returns when the run started, by the engine's clock, as RunContext.startedAt() describes it: the instant that judged every rule's validity window. A fixed clock gives every run the same instant. It isn't comparable to RuleSetInfo.loadedAt() or the run's deadline.
      Returns:
      The instant, or null if the result was created with of(...) and not given a run
